title: Buena Onda Bikes: Taiwan Made Batch Built Titanium Hardtail Pre-Order
content:
Buena Onda Bikes has been building bikes in the USA for nearly five years. Designing and refining the Buena alongside our manufacturing partner in Durango has allowed the small brand to iterate quickly and make sure the bike rides exactly as intended: capable on technical trails, loaded or unloaded, and ready for demanding riders. After refining that design through its US-built frames, the Durango-based company set out to make it more accessible. By producing frames in batches with our manufacturing partner in Taiwan, Buena Onda Bikes are able to bring the same proven geometry to more riders at a lower price point of $3,100 for a frame…

Buena Onda Bikes Quick Hits

  • Frame only: Starting at $3,100
  • Eagle 90 complete build: $6,250
  • AXS complete build: $8,400
  • Tubeset: Size-specific Double Butted Titanium Tubing
  • Optimal Fork Travel for Suspension Builds: 130mm
  • Rear Hub Spacing: 148 x 12
  • Bottom Bracket: T47 Threaded, 73 mm
  • Dropouts: Horizontal Sliding Dropouts with 16mm of fore/aft adjustment. Each frame ships standard with UDH-compatible dropouts and a removable derailleur hanger.
  • Seatpost: Straight seat tube, 31.6 mm ream, 34.9 collar
  • Cable Routing: Externally routed with M5 bolt securement. Internal routing through the seat tube for a dropper post.
  • Bottle Mounts: 2x bottle cages in frame, triple bottle cage mounting on downtube
  • Rack Mounts: Upper and lower hourglass-style rack eyelets standard on all frames
  • Headtube/Headset: 44 mm head tube / ZS44/28.6 EC44/40 Headset
  • Max tire clearance: 29 x 2.6

Made in Taiwan

Our Taiwanese manufacturer was selected for its advanced capabilities, experience working with titanium, and high level of craftsmanship. These batch-built frames begin with the same flagship geometry we have tested and refined in Durango, then are engineered for larger-scale production.

Intentionally selected butted titanium tubing provides a balance of durability, comfort, and ride quality.

Designed for the Colorado Trail, whether you are heading out for a day ride or tackling all 539 miles, the Buena is built to go the distance. Loaded or unloaded. Built around a 130mm fork, it balances comfort and capability with geometry grounded in function, not fads: a 66.5° head tube angle, 75.5° straight seat tube angle, room for racks and bottles, and space for a large frame bag.

MUSA Option

MUSA frames are still available on a custom basis. Each MUSA build is made in the good ol’ USA by our manufacturing partner in Durango, Colorado. The process begins with our proven geometry, then we tailor the sizing around the rider so you are not forced to choose between standard sizes.

From there, you select the components that best match how and where you ride for a truly custom bike.

Frame Details

Tubing: Size-specific, double-butted Grade 9 titanium, with thinner wall sections through the middle of the tube where we can save weight without giving up strength where it matters. Include headtube gussets.

Head Badge: Custom-designed and hand-fabricated by Revolution Jewelry.
Finish: Ceramic Bead Blast with Brushed Logo.

The frames are built by our partner manufacturer in Taiwan in small production runs, using the same proven geometry and spec we tested and refined on our US-built frames. Batch-built frames come with a headtube gusset and external routing. Small and Extra Small frames will be available in the second batch.

Geometry and Warranty

Based on a 2.6″ tire and 20% sagged numbers.

Every Buena Onda frame is built to be ridden hard, loaded up, depended on, and kept around for life. Our limited lifetime warranty covers manufacturer defects in materials and workmanship for the original owner, because if something is on us, we will make it right.

Bikes are also meant to be used, and sometimes that means crashes, mistakes, bad lines, roof racks, baggage handlers, and the occasional questionable decision. Those situations are not covered under warranty, but we will offer discounted crash replacement support whenever possible to help keep you on your Buena.

Ordering Process

Getting on a batch-built Buena is straightforward.

Place a Deposit. Put down a 50% deposit to reserve your spot in the production queue. Pre-sales open November 16th.

Confirmation. Batch-built lead times run roughly 4 months after the pre-order window closes.
Build and Delivery. When your frame exits production, we collect the remaining balance, complete the build, and ship your bike. Local Durango pickup is available. Bikes from this batch deliver in April.
As a thank you for supporting us early, riders in this first batch get introductory pricing on these initial runs.

See more at Buena Onda Bikes.
